# Risk and capital efficiency of b (generated by market/risk_frontier.py; do not edit by hand)

Full-year replay grid, each city's walk-forward test months only, fee fixed at $0.05. Expected capital = mean of b·ln(1/π_winner) = b × the opening prior's log loss; worst-case capital = mean of b·ln(1/min π).
